name: Victoria Bryant State Park
evidence: GA State Parks 2025 park/campground map (per-site inset, sites 1-27 + platforms): no water inside the campground; Rice Creek and both ponds lie elsewhere in the park. Satellite 34.2978,-83.1652 canopy-blind, gap unresolved; no source puts RV pads on water

name: Trackrock Campground & Cabins
evidence: Operator site map: pond ('Lake') has only a beach marked no vehicles and cabins, no RV site on it; satellite 34.8600,-83.8715 agrees. Map draws a small stream by sites 70-76; satellite 34.8613,-83.8702 shows only a thin drainage, water unseen under trees, so unconfirmed

name: Whitetail Ridge Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site Proximity to Water: 43 of 58 sites Lakefront, all electric, RV allowed, 30-75 ft. Site coords on satellite 33.0190,-85.1780 and 33.0172,-85.1810: sites 39-42, 19-20, 56 at the high-water edge on West Point Lake, 40 and 56 on open ground; drawdown beach not counted against

name: Woodring Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site tag Lakefront on electric sites 028-030, 032, 034, 035 (drive-in, 32-40 ft; 035 lists RV/Motorhome; 027 max 0 ft and 033 Boat-In excluded). Plotted on narrow forested fingers ~20 m or less from Carters Lake, satellite 34.6100,-84.6450 canopy-blind but consistent; DEM 330 m vs pool ~327 m, no bluff shown

name: Whitewater Creek County Park
evidence: Macon County official per-site map (Whitewater-Park-Maps.pdf): RV sites 21-24 and 26 at the shore of what it names White Water Pond, dam at far east end, sites upstream. Satellite 32.3508,-84.0720: open grass from south-loop pads to the water/lily edge ~15-25 m, no treeline. Primitive and cabin sites not counted

name: Cedar Creek RV & Outdoor Center
evidence: Satellite 34.1352,-85.3110 (z19): north-row pads, mid-row, open unused lawn ~15-20 m to Big Cedar Creek water, no trees in that gap; elsewhere bank trees screen. Operator map v5 shows this row along the creek; Campspot sells Creekside Back-In FHU nightly at $44. Prior 'continuous wooded bank' contradicted here

name: Broad River Campground
evidence: Satellite 33.9755,-82.6291 and Wayback 2024-01 full pool: canopy; only a tan clearing ~20 m from water, behind a tree row, not confirmed as an RV pad; other pads 40-60 m+. Firefly sells an 'RV Site - Water Access' class but unit list/map sit behind reCAPTCHA, so no per-site source; default down

name: Diamond Lakes Regional Park Campground
evidence: Satellite 33.3498,-82.0935 (z19, leaf-off) + Wayback 2024-01: pads on the SW pond shore ~15-20 m from water across a footpath and a thin fringe of bare trees; site numbers approximate, leaf-on screening unknown, coarse DEM 73 m at pads vs 64 m on the pond, so a steep bank is not ruled out. Pond not earned, default down.
